1001.description: A single-leg split squat with a band. It trains the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a resistance band around your ankles.
Take a big step forward with your right foot and a smaller step back with your left foot.
Bend your knees and lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your left knee slightly above the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将阻力带绕在脚踝上。
右脚向前迈一大步，左脚向后退一小步。
弯曲膝盖并降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行，保持左膝盖略高于地面。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。

1065.description: A glute bridge with your feet or upper back on a stability ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels resting on the stability ball.
Press your arms into the floor for support.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips under control.
Keep the ball steady throughout.

1129.description: A reverse lunge with the hands on the straps for balance, working the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand tall, facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Press through the front heel to return.
Use the straps for balance only.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

1193.description: A plank variation with arms and legs spread wide to challenge the core.
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Spread your arms and legs wide in an X shape.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

1257.description: A reverse-grip bench press on an incline bench. It trains the upper chest and triceps.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
反握抓住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1321.description: A seated cable row using a rope from an elevated seat position. It trains the upper back, lats and biceps with a neutral grip.
instructions: Sit on the elevated seat facing the cable machine.
Grab the cable rope handles with an overhand grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly back, maintaining a slight bend in your knees.
Pull the cable towards your body by retracting your shoulder blades and squeezing your back muscles.
Pause for a moment at the fully contracted position.
Slowly release the tension and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在面向电缆机的高架座椅上。
正手握住缆绳手柄，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直并稍微向后倾斜，保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
通过缩回肩胛骨并挤压背部肌肉，将电缆拉向您的身体。
在完全收缩的位置暂停片刻。
慢慢释放压力并将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1385.description: A calf raise performed on a leg press machine by pressing with your toes. It builds the calves with a stable, supported load.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the footplate, shoulder-width apart.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the footplate, keeping your heels off the edge.
Release the safety handles and push the footplate away from you by extending your knees.
Once your knees are fully extended, slowly lower your heels by flexing your calves.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the footplate back up by extending your calves.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整压腿机的座椅，使双脚放在踏板上时膝盖稍微弯曲。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在踏板上，与肩同宽。
将脚趾和脚掌放在踏板上，使脚后跟远离边缘。
松开安全手柄，并通过伸展膝盖将踏板推离您。
一旦膝盖完全伸展，弯曲小腿，慢慢降低脚后跟。
在底部停顿片刻，然后通过伸展小腿将踏板向后推。
重复所需的重复次数。

1449.description: A static hold at the bottom of an incline flye. It teaches chest tension and builds control in the stretched position.
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Open your arms wide with soft elbows until the dumbbells are level with your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back and down.
Hold the stretched position for 15-30 seconds without sagging.
Bring the weights back together over your chest and set them down carefully.

1513.description: A hip hinge with a band across your shoulders. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Stand on the band and loop it behind your neck across your shoulders.
Keep your knees softly bent and your back flat.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.

1577.description: A lying stretch that opens the front of the hip. Handy after long periods of sitting.
instructions: Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed.
Hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the knee relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

1641.description: A seated cable biceps curl. The seat keeps you steady so the biceps do the lifting.
instructions: Sit on a cable machine with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Grasp the cable attachment with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the cable attachment towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the cable attachment back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在缆绳机上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
反手抓住电缆附件，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将电缆附件卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将电缆附件放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1705.description: A squat on a bosu ball. It trains the quads and glutes and tests balance.
instructions: Place the bosu ball on the ground with the flat side up.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and position yourself on top of the bosu ball.
Lower your body down by bending your knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your weight on your heels.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将博苏球平放在地上。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将自己放在博苏球的顶部。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸，将体重放在脚后跟上。
降低身体直到大腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1769.description: A bodyweight curl performed while lying on your side. A gentle way to train the biceps without equipment.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by your arm.
Hold your upper arm against your side and bend your elbow to curl your forearm towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸直，用手臂支撑头部。
将上臂靠在身体两侧，弯曲肘部，将前臂卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1833.description: Tilting your head back stretches the front of the neck. Go slowly and stay within a comfortable range.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling, keeping your jaw relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1897.description: Stretch for the inner thigh with one leg raised and out to the side.
instructions: Stand next to a bench or low support.
Place one foot on it with the leg out to the side.
Keep your hips square.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1961.description: A deep squat on the balls of the feet that stretches the toes and the bottom of the feet.
instructions: Crouch down with your heels lifted and toes tucked under.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you for support.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the toes and soles stretch.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.

2089.description: A simple stretch that opens the fingers and forearm muscles, useful after typing or gripping.
instructions: Hold one arm out in front of you with the elbow straight.
Use the other hand to gently pull the fingers back until you feel a stretch in the palm and forearm.
Keep the fingers straight and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2153.description: A deep squat with a band for added resistance, training the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Keep your chest up and your core braced.
Sit your hips back and down into a full squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes and heels on the floor.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

2345.description: A side-by-side form check for leg position on the hack squat sled, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Set your back and shoulders against the pads and place your feet on the platform.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees track over your toes and your feet sit flat on the platform.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2409.description: Lying on your back with a weighted head harness, you lift your chin toward your chest to train the neck flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and the harness fitted.
Let your head hang back slightly in a comfortable range.
Curl your chin toward your chest slowly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and keep the weight light with smooth reps.

2473.description: A single-leg bridge with a foot on a bench that targets the glutes harder.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot on a bench and the other leg extended.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2665.description: A machine pulldown with a wide grip that targets the lats for a broad back.
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grip the wide handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, leading with the elbows.
Squeeze the lats, then let the handles rise slowly.
Avoid leaning far back or using momentum.

2729.description: A heavy deadlift in strongman style, pulling a loaded bar from the floor to a full stand. Builds total posterior chain and grip strength.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over mid foot.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your knees, chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and push the floor away, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Stand tall by driving your hips forward, then lower the bar under control.

2793.description: Moving between a forearm and a high plank, building core and arm endurance.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand and then the other on the floor to rise to a high plank.
Lower one forearm and then the other back down.
Keep your hips steady.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.

2857.description: A rocking move on the stomach that stretches the front and strengthens the back.
instructions: Lie face down and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and legs.
Rock forward and back.
Keep your movement smooth.
Lower down to finish.

2921.description: A push-up with hips lifted high so you press more overhead. It builds shoulder strength using only your body weight.
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips into an inverted V.
Keep your arms and back straight.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

3113.description: A jumping move where your legs split front and back while your arms swing. It's a light, fast cardio burst.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Jump one foot forward and the other back as you swing opposite arms.
Land softly with soft knees.
Jump again and switch legs.
Keep your torso upright.
Continue at a steady pace for 30-45 seconds.

3241.description: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the ankles. It trains the calves.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place an exercise ball between the wall and your lower back.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
在墙壁和下背部之间放置一个健身球。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将网球放在脚踝之间。
将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3305.description: A front squat followed by an overhead press in one fluid movement with a barbell. It trains the legs, shoulders and heart rate.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your heels to stand up, simultaneously pressing the barbell overhead.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height as you lower back into the squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，与肩同高。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低至蹲姿。
当你到达深蹲底部时，爆发性地通过脚后跟站起来，同时将杠铃压过头顶。
当你回到深蹲位置时，将杠铃降低到肩膀高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

3369.description: Squatting while whipping the battle ropes with alternating arms. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
instructions: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit into a squat position.
Whip the ropes up and down with alternating arms.
Keep your chest tall and your knees stable.
Continue for a set time at a steady pace.

3433.description: A face-down flutter kick, lifting the chest and legs off the floor and kicking in a swimming motion. It trains the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead.
Engage your core and lift your chest and legs off the ground simultaneously.
Kick your legs up and down in a fluttering motion, as if you were swimming.
Continue kicking for the desired number of repetitions.
Lower your chest and legs back down to the starting position.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在垫子上，双臂伸过头顶。
启动核心肌群，同时将胸部和腿部抬离地面。
以扑动的动作上下踢腿，就像在游泳一样。
继续踢所需的重复次数。
将胸部和双腿放低至起始位置。

3497.description: Slide your hands along the floor on a towel, from overhead down toward your sides. It teaches a pulldown pattern for the lats.
instructions: Kneel or lie face down with your hands on towels on a smooth floor.
Start with your arms extended overhead.
Press down and pull your arms back toward your hips, sliding the towels.
Squeeze your lats at the end.
Slide the hands back overhead with control.
Keep your core braced.

3561.description: A glute bridge held at the top while you alternate marching the knees. It trains the glutes and core stability.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
While keeping your hips lifted, lift one foot off the ground and bring your knee towards your chest.
Lower your foot back to the ground and repeat the movement with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs in a marching motion while maintaining the bridge position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在保持臀部抬起的同时，将一只脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
将脚放回地面，然后用另一条腿重复该动作。
继续交替双腿进行行进动作，同时保持桥式姿势。
重复所需的重复次数。

3689.description: A seated single-arm raise that targets the front of the shoulder without leg drive helping out.
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in one hand, arm down at your thigh.
Raise the dumbbell straight in front of you to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly back to your thigh.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3881.description: A seated machine crunch that works the full abdominal wall with adjustable resistance.
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with the pads in position.
Hold the handles and keep your feet planted.
Exhale and curl your torso forward, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips on the seat.

3945.description: A one-arm row against the Smith bar for a stable path. It builds the lats and upper back, one side at a time.
instructions: Set the bar at a low height and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Grip the bar with one hand and brace the other on your thigh.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

4009.description: A crunch with the arms extended overhead, which lengthens the lever and makes it harder. It focuses on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms straight overhead.
Bend your knees.
Crunch up reaching forward.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms by your ears.

4073.description: Chest fly with the band anchored low, so you sweep your arms up and together. It focuses on the upper chest.
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Start with arms out to the sides and slightly bent.
Sweep your hands up and together in front of your chest.
Return slowly.

4137.description: A squat paired with a band twist for core and legs.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways, holding the end.
Squat down.
Rise and rotate your arms away from the anchor.
Return to the center.
Complete all reps, then switch sides.

4201.description: A bench press with chains adding load.
instructions: Lie on bench.
Unrack the bar.
Lower to chest.
Press up.
Lock out.
Keep feet planted.

4329.description: A push-up variation with hands on a sturdy chair. It makes pressing easier while still training chest and arms.
instructions: Place a stable chair against a wall and set your hands on the seat edge.
Walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Lower your chest toward the seat, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.

4393.description: A seated twisting exercise with a kettlebell that targets the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back a little.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Lift your feet slightly if you can, and keep your back straight.
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other.
Move with control and keep your chest lifted.

4457.description: A side plank on a bent knee holding a dumbbell. Strengthens the obliques and trunk while teaching stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, resting on your hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from head to knees.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep your hips stacked and do not sink.
Lower and switch sides after your set.

4521.description: A push-up with your hands on kettlebell handles for a deeper range of motion. It builds the chest and arms.
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Extend your legs into a plank position.
Lower your chest between the handles with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up until your arms are straight and repeat.

4585.description: A straight front kick thrown low at a bag, training leg power and balance.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag with hands up.
Lift your rear knee toward your chest.
Extend your leg and drive the ball of your foot into the bag.
Lean back slightly to stay balanced.
Pull your leg back quickly.
Return to your stance and switch sides.

4777.description: Lying face down, you lift your legs behind you to extend the hips. It strengthens the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front or under your head.
Keep your legs straight.
Raise both legs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

4841.description: A barbell deadlift with a band that assists off the floor. It lets you train heavy lockout work and hip drive.
instructions: Attach a band to the barbell and anchor it overhead or to a rack.
Stand with the bar over midfoot and grip just outside your knees.
Brace and push the floor away to lift.
Stand tall and lock out your hips.
Lower with control.

4905.description: A glute ham raise with a band for assistance, a third variation. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Set up on a glute ham bench with your ankles locked and a band for support.
Cross your arms or hold the band in front of you.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a straight body.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Move slowly and avoid jerking.

5033.description: One-arm pushdown with a rope on a high cable. The rope lets you spread the ends at the bottom for a strong triceps squeeze.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip it with one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Press the rope down until your arm is straight, turning the end out slightly.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

5097.description: Press dumbbells on a decline bench one arm at a time. It hits the lower chest and keeps your core working to stay balanced.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell to the side of your chest.
Press it back up until your arm is straight.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your core tight and the bench-side arm steady.

5161.description: Squat down with a medicine ball, then drive up and throw it against a wall. It trains explosive power through the legs and shoulders.
instructions: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up explosively and throw the ball at the wall.
Catch the ball on the rebound with soft hands.
Reset your stance and repeat for controlled reps.

5225.description: A wide-grip shrug with the Smith bar held behind your body. It shifts the load toward the back of the traps.
instructions: Stand with your back to the bar, set at thigh height, and grip it wide behind you.
Lift the bar off the hooks and stand tall.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your arms straight.

5481.description: Gentle seated mobility drill sliding the foot along the floor to warm up the ankle and calf.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Keep your heel down and slide the foot forward along the floor.
Pull it back, letting the heel lift slightly toward the end.
Move smoothly through a comfortable range.
Repeat, then switch feet.

5609.description: Cable face pull to build the rear delts and strengthen the upper back.
instructions: Set a cable at upper chest height with a handle.
Stand tall and pull toward your face.
Spread your hands apart at the end.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

5737.description: A bodyweight chest fly using suspension straps. You open your arms wide while leaning forward to stretch and load the chest.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with your body in a straight line.
Start with your arms out in front of you, slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides, lowering your chest between the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your chest to bring your arms back together.

5801.description: A muscle up where a band under your feet or knees takes some of your weight. It lets you learn the pull and transition on the bar.
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang from the bar with a false or overhand grip.
Pull explosively, bringing your chest to the bar.
Lean over the bar and press yourself up to straight arms.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.

5865.description: Jump squats that alternate between a wide and a narrow stance. It builds explosive leg power and gets your heart rate up.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and squat down.
Jump up, bringing your feet together mid-air.
Land softly in a narrow stance and squat.
Jump again, landing back in the wide stance.
Keep your chest up and move at a steady pace.

6057.description: A floor or bench press with a bottle in each hand. It builds the chest and triceps with light load.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle in each hand at chest level.
Press the bottles straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep your wrists straight.
Lower slowly until your elbows touch the floor or reach chest level.
Repeat for your reps.

6121.description: The half spinal twist, a seated yoga pose. It stretches the spine and outer hip and improves rotation.
instructions: Sit tall with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and place that foot outside the opposite thigh.
Hug the bent knee with the opposite arm.
Place your other hand behind you and twist toward it.
Lengthen the spine and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.

6441.description: Rotating the forearm outward against a band, elbow at your side. It strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles that steady the shoulder.
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Rotate the forearm outward, keeping the elbow pinned.
Pause when your hand points forward or slightly out.
Return slowly under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

6761.description: A floor stretch with one shin folded in front. It opens the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Start on all fours and bring one knee forward behind your wrist.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Square your hips to the floor.
Fold forward gently over the front leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.

7209.description: A kneeling leg sweep against a band that works the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with the band around your thighs or foot.
Lift one leg out to the side with a bent knee.
Sweep it in a half circle, back and up.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Reverse the circle to return.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7593.description: A sled leg press with a foot position that puts more load on the glutes. It also works the quads and hamstrings.
instructions: Sit in the sled and place your feet high and wide on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the seat.
Push through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
Lower under control for each rep.

8297.description: A straight-arm pulldown using a rope. It isolates the lats with no help from the arms.
instructions: Set a rope on a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hinge forward slightly with arms extended.
Pull the rope down to your thighs.
Spread the rope at the bottom.
Return slowly.

8361.description: A band drill that strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles on the back of the shoulder.
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the elbow tucked at your side, bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly, keeping the elbow fixed.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

8617.description: A seated rotation drill for the back of the shoulders and rotator cuff.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Tuck your elbows at your sides bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms outward, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly and repeat.

8873.description: A lying knee raise holding a dumbbell between your feet or legs, challenging the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell secured between your feet.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your feet slowly without touching the floor.
Repeat for controlled reps.

9321.description: Small alternating kicks while lying down. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20 to 40 seconds.

9385.description: A hybrid of a close grip bench press and skull crusher done on a smith machine. It loads the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench under the smith bar with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chin or upper chest by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows slightly in.
Press the bar back up.
Use a light weight and control the path.

9513.description: A vertical jump with a quick dip and an arm swing that adds momentum. It builds explosive leg power.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms back.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat while swinging your arms down and back.
Swing your arms forward and up as you explode off the floor.
Extend fully through hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

9705.description: Lying on the floor, you lift a cable handle up in front of you to isolate the front delts.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and hold the handle.
Start with your arm by your thigh.
Raise your arm up over your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch arms.

10345.description: Lie face down and lift arms and legs with small pulses. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches.
Pulse them up and down in small movements.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower and rest after your set.

10537.description: Seated on a chair, you straighten one knee to lift your foot. A gentle move that wakes up the thigh.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Slowly straighten one knee to lift your foot.
Squeeze your thigh at the top for a second.
Lower the foot back to the floor with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10665.description: A planche hold with your elbows tucked into your waist. It is an early step toward a full planche.
instructions: Place your hands on the floor and tuck your elbows into your waist.
Lean forward over your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor one at a time.
Hold your body level with a tight core.
Keep your shoulders pressed forward.
Lower down after the hold.

10729.description: Pedal your legs in the water as if cycling. It raises your heart rate with low impact.
instructions: Stand in chest-deep water, holding the pool edge.
Lift your knees alternately.
Pedal at a steady rhythm.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for several minutes.

10857.description: A slow, loaded forward bend that rolls through the spine. Keep the barbell light and the motion smooth.
instructions: Stand holding a very light barbell in front of your thighs.
Tuck your chin and roll down one segment at a time.
Let the bar hang close to your legs.
Go only as low as feels controlled.
Roll back up slowly.
Keep your knees soft.

10921.description: A seated band-resisted knee extension that you hold at the top. It builds quad endurance.
instructions: Sit on a chair with a band anchored around one ankle behind you.
Straighten that knee against the band.
Hold the leg straight for 10-20 seconds.
Keep the thigh tight and your back upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

11049.description: Seated knee abduction with the feet lifted. It trains the outer hips and core.
instructions: Sit tall and lift your feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees outward.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

0041.description: A straight-arm raise of the bar in front of you to shoulder height. Targets the front delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and lift the barbell forward and upward until it reaches shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃于大腿前方。
保持手臂伸直，向前向上举起杠铃，直至达到肩部水平。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0105.description: A standing Bradford press, lifting the bar from the front of the shoulders to behind the head and back. Works the delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Press the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃于肩前。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0169.description: An incline cable press. Emphasises the upper chest.
instructions: Adjust the bench to a 45-degree incline.
Attach the cable handles to the high pulleys.
Sit on the bench facing the cable machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and bring them to shoulder height.
Push the handles forward and upward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将长凳调整至 45 度倾斜。
将电缆手柄连接到高滑轮上。
坐在长凳上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，并将其拉至肩部高度。
向前和向上推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0233.description: A standing cable row with a rope or attachment pulled toward the body. It targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable attachment with both hands, palms facing each other, and step back to create tension in the cable.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the cable towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the cable back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用双手握住电缆附件，手掌相对，然后后退以在电缆中产生张力。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将电缆拉向您的身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在运动的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开绳索回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0297.description: A seated one-arm curl with the elbow braced on the inner thigh. The brace stops cheating and focuses on the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs spread apart and a dumbbell in one hand, resting your elbow on the inside of your thigh.
Fully extend your arm and hold the dumbbell with an underhand grip.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight up towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双腿分开，一只手拿着哑铃，肘部放在大腿内侧。
完全伸展手臂并用反手握住哑铃。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将重量向上弯向肩膀，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0361.description: You press one dumbbell from shoulder height to overhead. It builds the shoulders and triceps one side at a time.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder level, palm facing forward.
Press the dumbbell upward until your arm is fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0425.description: Standing, you curl one dumbbell with an overhand grip. It works the biceps, the muscle under them and the forearm.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Keep your arm fully extended and close to your body, with your palm facing down.
Slowly curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，一只手握住哑铃，正握。
保持手臂完全伸展并靠近身体，手掌朝下。
慢慢地将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0489.description: Using a hyperextension bench, you lower and raise your torso. It strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Adjust the hyperextension bench so that your upper thighs are resting on the pad and your feet are secured.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise your upper body back up until it is in line with your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整过度伸展凳，使大腿上部放在垫子上并且双脚固定。
双臂交叉放在胸前或将双手放在脑后。
将上半身压向地面，同时保持背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后抬起上半身，直到与双腿成一直线。
重复所需的重复次数。

0553.description: Standing, you press a kettlebell in each hand overhead from shoulder height. Builds shoulder and triceps strength with a braced core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the kettlebells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个壶铃，与肩同高，手掌朝前。
启动你的核心并将壶铃压过头顶，充分伸展你的手臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将壶铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0617.description: A side-lying leg lift done on the floor. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your core tight.
Raise your top leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your toes pointing forward.
Lower slowly without touching the other leg.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

0681.description: A knee push-up that adds a rotation to reach upward. It works the chest and the trunk.
instructions: Start in a push-up position on your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Rotate your torso and lift one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the arm to the floor.
Alternate sides.

0809.description: A split squat with the rear foot in a suspension strap. It builds the quads and glutes and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand facing away from a suspension trainer with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one leg forward and place the top of your foot in the foot cradle of the suspension trainer.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down into a lunge position, keeping your chest up and your knee in line with your toes.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
instructionsZh: 背对悬吊训练器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
向前伸展一条腿，将脚背放在悬吊训练器的脚托中。
弯曲站立的腿，将身体降低到弓步位置，保持胸部向上，膝盖与脚趾对齐。
推动脚后跟返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。

0873.description: A reverse crunch using a low cable, curling the hips off the mat. It trains the lower abs.
instructions: Attach a cable to a low pulley and lie down facing up on a mat.
Hold the cable with both hands and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Bend your knees and lift your legs up, bringing your thighs towards your chest.
While keeping your upper body stable, curl your pelvis up towards your chest, lifting your hips off the mat.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆连接到低滑轮上，然后面朝上躺在垫子上。
用双手握住电缆，并将双臂伸向天花板。
弯曲膝盖并抬起双腿，使大腿靠近胸部。
在保持上半身稳定的同时，将骨盆向胸部弯曲，将臀部抬离垫子。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
